info.title: Maxwell Positive Sum API
info.description: Helps people shape options for goals in the Positive Sum network. Vocabulary: a goal has an initial state and a desired state; a policy (offer) is someone's standing terms; an option is a specific proposed action with an initial state, a policy (how it's done) and a final state (what counts as done, with photo evidence).

get.description: Get a goal, the options already suggested for it, and the open offers (policies) in its organization. Call this first when helping someone shape an option for a goal. Information is always free to read.

parameters.name: goal_id
parameters.description: The goal's id. Defaults to the action currently being discussed.

200.description: The goal, its options, and open offers

post.description: Save an option for a goal. Use this ONLY after the person has seen the full option (starting point, how it's done, what counts as done, people needed) and explicitly confirms it ('yes', 'save it', 'looks good'). Never invoke without confirmation. Never include payment or compensation terms: value returns from the network, not per transaction.

parameters.name: goal_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated goal ids this option serves. Defaults to the goal being discussed.

parameters.name: policy_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated ids of offers (policies) the option is built from. Their owners become the implementors and must agree unless the association default applies. Omit when the person is suggesting to do it themselves.

parameters.name: initial_state
parameters.description: Starting point and conditions, e.g. what a tool may be used for

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: How it's done (method and conditions), without compensation terms

parameters.name: final_state
parameters.description: What counts as done, including the photos that show it (e.g. harvest photo and return photo of a borrowed tool)

parameters.name: parent_option_id
parameters.description: Set when this is a suggested change to an existing option (counterproposal)
